description.zh:
智能告警事件类型：

- 设置为全部智能告警事件：0。
- 设置为多个智能告警事件：输入智能告警事件对应的序号，并用英文逗号（,）分隔，例如：`10001,10002`。
>设置多个智能告警事件时，单次最多支持设置10个。

请在物联网平台控制台，**产品详情**页面的**功能定义**页签，查看全部智能告警事件类型。详细信息，请参考[查看智能告警事件类型](~~207701~~)。
description.en:
The intelligent alert event types.

- To specify all intelligent alert event types, set this parameter to 0.
- To specify multiple intelligent alert event types, enter the serial numbers of the event types and separate them with commas (,). Example: `10001,10002`.
>You can specify up to 10 intelligent alert event types at a time.

To view all intelligent alert event types, go to the **Feature Definition** tab on the **Product Details** page in the IoT Platform console. For more information, see [View intelligent alert event types](~~207701~~).

description.zh:
智能告警事件录像名称。

名称长度小于48个字符，可以包含英文字母、数字和特殊字符：短划线（-）、下划线（_）、at（@）、英文句号（.）、英文冒号（:）。
description.en:
The name of the intelligent alert event recording.

The name must be fewer than 48 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and the following special characters: hyphens (-), underscores (_), at signs (@), periods (.), and colons (:).

description.zh: 智能告警事件录像计划ID。可调用[QueryEventRecordPlans](~~107907~~)查询。
description.en: The ID of the intelligent alert event recording plan. You can call [QueryEventRecordPlans](~~107907~~) to query the ID.

description.zh:
预录时长，取值范围0~10，单位为秒。

>设备具备预录功能时，才可生成预录时长，否则，预录时长为0。
description.en:
The pre-recording duration. Valid values: 0 to 10. Unit: seconds.

>The pre-recording duration is generated only when the device supports the pre-recording feature. Otherwise, the pre-recording duration is 0.

description.zh: 录像时长，包括预录时长，取值范围10~60，单位为秒。
description.en: The recording duration, including the pre-recording duration. Valid values: 10 to 60. Unit: seconds.
The ID of the time template. You can call [QueryTimeTemplate](~~107890~~) to query the ID.

title.zh: 更新事件联动录像计划
